assets.caption: The scene is an automotive research and development design studio laboratory, presented in a realistic style with a moody and sophisticated tone, characteristic of a high-tech industrial environment. The overall ambiance is clean and modern, emphasizing precision and innovation. The space is dimly lit by strategic overhead lights, highlighting the interactive holographic table at the center, which serves as a focal point for design work. The walls are constructed from a dark, industrial material, possibly polished concrete or metal, contributing to the serious and focused atmosphere of the studio. Vehicle blueprints and intricate sketches are meticulously displayed on large, illuminated panels along the walls, showcasing various stages of automotive design and engineering. Workbenches and design stations are strategically placed throughout the studio, each equipped with advanced tools and computer monitors, facilitating detailed design and analysis. Additional holographic displays are integrated into other work surfaces, allowing for collaborative and interactive design sessions on various components of the car, extending the capabilities of the central display. The layout emphasizes functionality and efficiency, with ample clear space around the interactive displays to allow multiple designers to view and manipulate holographic projections simultaneously. The dark industrial aesthetic is maintained across all elements, from the flooring, which could be dark epoxy or polished concrete, to the minimalist furniture that complements the high-tech equipment. The 360 scene is faultless.
